    "body": "**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin-toolchain/compare/v0.12.2...v0.13.0\r\n\r\nStay tuned for our release blog post, which will present the highlights.\r\n\r\n### Breaking changes\r\n\r\n* [KTC-5543](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5543) — Rename AMPER_BUILD_DIR env var to KOTLIN_TOOLCHAIN_BUILD_DIR\r\n* [KTC-5733](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5733) — Update default Kotlin version to 2.4.20\r\n* [KTC-5853](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5853) — Don't hardcode the namespace for Android libraries\r\n* [KTC-5856](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5856) — Fail build with clear diagnostic when namespace or applicationId is missing in module.yaml \r\n* [KTC-5952](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5952) — Update default Compose version to 1.12.1\r\n* [KTC-5953](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5953) — Update default Ktor version to 3.6.0\r\n* [KTC-5954](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5954) — Update default Spring Boot version to 4.1.1\r\n* [KTC-5955](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5955) — Update default KSP version to 2.3.12\r\n* [KTC-5956](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5956) — Update default kotlinx.rpc version to 0.10.4\r\n* [KTC-5957](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5957) — Update default Lombok version to 1.18.48\r\n* [KTC-5972](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5972) — Rename the 'amper' module layout to 'default'\r\n\r\n### New features\r\n\r\n* [KTC-679](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-679) — Check and/or provision Xcode components automatically\r\n* [KTC-3585](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-3585) — Support consuming Compose Resources from published libraries\r\n* [KTC-4627](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-4627) — Support JUnit tags for test filtering\r\n* [KTC-5422](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5422) — Support Kotlin Native compiler caches in Kotlin Toolchain\r\n* [KTC-5478](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5478) — Support KMP wizard with Kotlin Toolchain CLI\r\n* [KTC-5549](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5549) — SwiftPM Initial Support\r\n* [KTC-5576](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5576) — Add testing of wasm modules\r\n* [KTC-5698](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5698) — Support publication of composeResources as a part of KMP library publication\r\n* [KTC-5784](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5784) — Reproducible JARs on clean rebuild\r\n* [KTC-5787](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5787) — Support `settings.kotlin.explicitApi` property and ignore it for test sources\r\n* [KTC-5832](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5832) — SwiftPM metadata is not published with kmp library\r\n* [KTC-5897](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5897) — Support explicit Android ABI filtering for application packaging\r\n* [KTC-5915](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5915) — Allow using dependencies from version catalog in `mavenPlugins(.dependencies)`\r\n\r\n### Cosmetics\r\n\r\n* [KTC-610](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-610) — Add a skin to the Android emulator created by Kotlin Toolchain\r\n* [KTC-5820](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5820) — SwiftPM import: Suppress verbose errors about unsupported modules from swift package \r\n* [KTC-5883](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5883) — Add a user-friendly error for dumpSwiftPMDependencyResolution\r\n\r\n### Usability improvements\r\n\r\n* [KTC-609](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-609) — Kotlin Toolchain installs Android SDK with non-canonical name (Amper-33)\r\n* [KTC-4232](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-4232) — Unify test output for different platforms in `pretty` (default) format\r\n* [KTC-4240](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-4240) — Compiler warnings are shown as error logs (and in stderr) for native compilations\r\n* [KTC-4720](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-4720) — Running ios app fails with \"Found no destinations for the scheme 'app' and action build\"\r\n* [KTC-4791](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-4791) — Compiler warnings are shown as error logs (and in stderr) for JS and Wasm compilations\r\n* [KTC-4801](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-4801) — Always print the full stacktrace of Internal errors\r\n* [KTC-5233](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5233) — Warning from Kotlin native compiler about using Unsafe API\r\n* [KTC-5479](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5479) — iOS: dependency Compose resources not bundled unless `compose: enabled` on the app module (MissingResourceException at runtime)\r\n* [KTC-5695](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5695) — Supported way to accept the Android SDK license without sdkmanager\r\n* [KTC-5777](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5777) — `kotlin run --module` with a non-app module should fail more clearly\r\n* [KTC-5785](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5785) — Prompt for single module selection in `show settings/dependencies` instead of multiple\r\n* [KTC-5816](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5816) — Hide '+zcm' is not a recognized feature error message\r\n* [KTC-5821](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5821) — Report progress of downloading tools, sdks, etc in the CLI\r\n* [KTC-5824](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5824) — Improve Compose Hot Reload discoverability in the CLI\r\n* [KTC-5830](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5830) — Unable to consume kmp library published to maven local with default settings\r\n* [KTC-5879](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5879) — If kotlin clean fails with Internal Error then stacktrace is unavailable\r\n* [KTC-5979](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5979) — Make `languageVersion` and `apiVersion` strings instead of enums\r\n\r\n### Fixed bugs\r\n\r\n* [KTC-4789](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-4789) — js/wasmjs linking failure \r\n* [KTC-5434](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5434) — Kotlin Toolchain generated AAR manifests missing `<uses-sdk>` cause spurious WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permission\r\n* [KTC-5602](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5602) — KSP fails with Room when building via Kotlin Toolchain \r\n* [KTC-5645](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5645) — CLI hangs forever when a KSP task fails\r\n* [KTC-5651](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5651) — Rename: update Xcode project in templates\r\n* [KTC-5686](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5686) — Executable JAR is broken with `settings.spring: enabled`\r\n* [KTC-5765](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5765) — IOException: Resource deadlock would occur\r\n* [KTC-5770](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5770) — Ctrl+C on WASM APP throws IllegalStateException: Shutdown in progress\r\n* [KTC-5776](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5776) — Compose 1.12.0 doesn't work (new skiko artifacts)\r\n* [KTC-5778](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5778) — 100% cache miss on executable jar creation\r\n* [KTC-5779](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5779) — Dependency classifier is ignored if dependency is published with Gradle module metadata\r\n* [KTC-5790](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5790) — Dependency resolution step hangs in IDE\r\n* [KTC-5795](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5795) — Incremental build does not restore deleted output .class files — kotlin run reports successful compilation but fails with ClassNotFoundException\r\n* [KTC-5797](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5797) — kmp/lib: settings.kotlin.serialization adds kotlinx-serialization-core to the POM once per fragment  \r\n* [KTC-5845](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5845) — Do not require to set `description` module property for publishing to Maven Central if `description` property in POM is already set\r\n* [KTC-5850](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5850) — K/Wasm: Process page errors during browser testing\r\n* [KTC-5860](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5860) — Compose Hot Reload prints a lot of empty lines during the reload\r\n* [KTC-5866](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5866) — Sporadic failures of Room: \"Failed to delete old native lib ... sqlitejdbc.dll\"\r\n* [KTC-5869](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5869) — Android run fails with internal error: AdbCommandRejectedException\r\n* [KTC-5875](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5875) — WasmJS and WasmWASI expose types from non-exported transitive dependencies\r\n* [KTC-5885](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5885) — Deprecated -Xwasm and -Xir-produce-klib-file flags are used for Wasm targets\r\n* [KTC-5896](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5896) — Dependency resolution sometimes produces a graph that includes the same library of two different versions\r\n* [KTC-5921](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5921) — `kotlin run` hangs indefinitely for Android application on clean cache on Windows\r\n* [KTC-5926](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5926) — Simulator window not opening with Xcode 27.0+\r\n* [KTC-5933](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5933) — Android library packages composeResources twice in (assets/ and inside the bundled jar)\r\n* [KTC-5935](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5935) — Android AAR silently drops Compose resource overrides from refined fragments\r\n* [KTC-5938](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5938) — ClassCastException while editing swift package dependency\r\n* [KTC-5940](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5940) — Common tests run for few random targets with KTC 0.13.0\r\n* [KTC-5950](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5950) — Hot reload fails with IllegalArgumentException in @DevelopmentEntryPoint preview in kmp/lib modules\r\n* [KTC-5960](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5960) — Android namespace fallback doesn't respect artifactId fallback\r\n* [KTC-5973](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5973) — Wrapper errors can lead to corrupted CLI distribution cache\r\n\r\n### IDE Improvements\r\n\r\nThese changes are available in the [Kotlin Toolchain plugin](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/31850-kotlin-toolchain) for IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.3.\r\n\r\n#### New features\r\n\r\n* [KTC-5590](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5590) — Debug Android unit tests\r\n* [KTC-5742](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5742) — Track local packages in IDE and rerun cinterops when manifests or sources change\r\n\r\n#### Cosmetics\r\n\r\n* [KTC-5914](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5914) — Generated run configurations have verbose prefix \"Module \"\r\n\r\n#### Usability improvements\r\n\r\n* [KTC-951](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-951) — The default android-app run configuration is not helpful if Android SDK is absent\r\n* [KTC-5512](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5512) — IDE automatically comments out inserted `//`-paths\r\n* [KTC-5812](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5812) — Improve Compose Hot Reload discoverability in the IDE\r\n* [KTC-5909](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5909) — Create run configurations earlier during the sync\r\n* [KTC-5910](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5910) — Create run configurations for iOS and Android apps if the KMP plugin is absent\r\n\r\n#### Fixed bugs\r\n\r\n* [KTC-5710](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5710) — Auto-sync does not work in Android Studio\r\n* [KTC-5716](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5716) — Cannot run parameterized test [KTC-5774](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5774) — Pasting Gradle-style dependencies doesn't add $ for catalog libs\r\n* [KTC-5786](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5786) — Pasting Gradle-style dependencies only works after '- '\r\n* [KTC-5813](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/KTC-5813) — Odd file tree when traversing from Gradle to KTC project\r\n*     "body": "**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin-toolchain/compare/v0.10.0...v0.11.0\r\n\r\nSee [our release default Lombok version to  1.18.46\r\n* [AMPER-5362](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5362) — Update default JUnit Platform version to 6.0.3\r\n\r\n### New features\r\n\r\n* [AMPER-471](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-471) — Support publishing to Maven Central\r\n* [AMPER-774](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-774) — Support dependency classifier \r\n* [AMPER-3984](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-3984) — Allow changing URLs for the default repositories (e.g. to use mirrors)\r\n* [AMPER-4852](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4852) — Introduce a way to hook custom tasks to commands\r\n* [AMPER-5085](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5085) — Provide API to get project root dir from a plugin\r\n* [AMPER-5098](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5098) — Support nested templates (templates applied in templates)\r\n* [AMPER-5120](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5120) — Provide access to classes (compilation result)\r\n* [AMPER-5262](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5262) — Support customizing the published pom.xml\r\n* [AMPER-5268](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5268) — Support signing maven artifacts\r\n* [AMPER-5269](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5269) — Allow resolving dev versions of the Kotlin compiler\r\n* [AMPER-5289](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5289) — Allow controlling whether to publish sourcesJar\r\n\r\n### Cosmetics\r\n\r\n* [AMPER-5356](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5356) — Diagnostic that suggests sorting a module list in project.yaml alphabetically\r\n\r\n### Usability improvements\r\n\r\n* failures are not shown\r\n* [AMPER-5374](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5374) — Set User Agent in dependency resolution calls\r\n\r\n### IDE Improvements\r\n\r\nThese changes are available in the [Kotlin Toolchain plugin](https://plugins.jetbrains.com/plugin/31850-kotlin-toolchain) for IntelliJ IDEA 2026.1.2.\r\n\r\n#### New features\r\n\r\n* [AMPER-5065](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5065) — Provide a quick fix to add a parameter to the task function from its usage in plugin.yaml\r\n* [AMPER-5197](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5197) — Add a \"Plugin settings class\" code vision hint\r\n* [AMPER-5210](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5210) — Ability to rename [AMPER-5229](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5229) — Quick-fix for JvmReleaseTooLowForDependency\r\n* [AMPER-5256](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5256) — Add a quick fix to bump JDK version if it is too low for the used JUnit platform\r\n* [AMPER-5266](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5266) — Completion for task names\r\n* [AMPER-5297](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5297) — Add support for setting platforms of test command in UI\r\n* [AMPER-5311](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5311) — Provide a [AMPER-5236](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-5236) — Provide documentation and navigation for elements in \"Add dependency\"\r\n*     "body": "**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin-toolchain/compare/v0.7.0...v0.8.0\r\n\r\nSee our [release blog post](https://blog.jetbrains.com/amper/2025/10/amper-update-october-2025/) for the highlights, and to learn about the tooling improvements.\r\n\r\n### Breaking changes\r\n\r\n* [AMPER-317](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-317) — Remove legacy `app` product type\r\n* [AMPER-4436](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4436) — Use current working dir by default in './amper run', and provide a CLI option to override it\r\n* [AMPER-4439](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4439) — Change cache directory from .../Amper to .../JetBrains/Amper\r\n* [AMPER-4441](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4441) — Remove Gradle-based Amper\r\n* [AMPER-4442](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4442) — Update default Compose version to 1.8.2\r\n* [AMPER-4520](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4520) — Simplify fragment hierarchy in android/app and jvm/app modules\r\n* [AMPER-4633](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4633) — Update default kotlinx.serialization version to 1.9.0\r\n* [AMPER-4634](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4634) — Update default Ktor version to 3.2.3\r\n* [AMPER-4635](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4635) — Update default Spring Boot version to 3.5.5\r\n* [AMPER-4637](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4637) — Update default Kotlin version to 2.2.10\r\n* [AMPER-4638](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4638) — Update default KSP version to 2.2.10-2.0.2\r\n* [AMPER-4690](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4690) — Update default Android compileSdk to API level 36\r\n\r\n> [!TIP]\r\n> Our cache directory location changed! It's now nested under the `JetBrains` directory with other JetBrains tools. To save disk space, feel free to clean up the old `Amper` cache one directory above. To find where the shared cache is on your machine, run `./amper --help` and check the default value for `--shared-caches-root`.\r\n\r\n> [!WARNING]\r\n> As previously announced, the Gradle plugin for Gradle-based Amper projects has now been removed, and there was no 0.8.0 publication of this plugin. Please give a try to the standalone Amper build tool and let us know what you think!\r\n\r\n### New features\r\n\r\n* [AMPER-424](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-424) — Make the Kotlin Compiler version configurable\r\n* [AMPER-503](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-503) — Possibility to resolve artifacts from a local repository (e.g. maven local)\r\n* [AMPER-652](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-652) — Add support for kotlin-power-assert\r\n* [AMPER-3938](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-3938) — Firework support (Compose Hot Reload)\r\n* [AMPER-4026](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4026) — CLI command that shows the dependency graph\r\n* [AMPER-4307](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4307) — Make JUnit Console Launcher version customizable\r\n* [AMPER-4355](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4355) — Java annotation processing support\r\n* [AMPER-4429](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4429) — Spring Hot Swap support\r\n* [AMPER-4432](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4432) — Interactive module selection for ./amper show settings\r\n* [AMPER-4469](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4469) — Add support for Android SDK API level 36\r\n* [AMPER-4521](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4521) — Introduce jvm/lib product type\r\n* [AMPER-4534](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4534) — Add freeCompilerArgs for the java compiler\r\n* [AMPER-4597](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4597) — Make lombok version configurable\r\n* [AMPER-4599](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4599) — Support libs.versions.toml at the project root in addition to gradle/libs.versions.toml\r\n* [AMPER-4636](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4636) — Make Compose hot reload version configurable\r\n* [AMPER-4645](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4645) — Add 'web' fragment, shared between js and wasmJs\r\n* [AMPER-4649](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4649) — Add support of wasmWasi platform\r\n\r\n> [!TIP]\r\n> If you have JVM-only `lib` modules, try out our new `jvm/lib` product type! It simplifies the overall experience.\r\n\r\n### Cosmetics\r\n\r\n* [AMPER-4433](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-4433) — Markdown code spans background is too intense on light theme in CLI [AMPER-669](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-669) — Provide explanation why CLI needs to download JDK\r\n* [AMPER-814](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-814) — './amper publish'     "body": "**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin-toolchain/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0\r\n\r\nSee our [release blog post](https://blog.jetbrains.com/amper/2024/08/amper-update-august-2024/) for the highlights, and to learn about the tooling improvements.\r\n\r\n### Breaking changes\r\n\r\n* [AMPER-760](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-760) Amper is now published to a new Maven repository.\r\n  This affects the Gradle plugin, as well as the standalone Amper distribution and executables:\r\n  * Old repository URL: `https://maven.pkg.jetbrains.space/public/p/amper/amper`\r\n  * New repository URL: `https://packages.jetbrains.team/maven/p/amper/amper`\r\n\r\n  See [Usage.md](docs/Usage.md) for instructions on how to update your project.\r\n\r\n* [AMPER-393](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-393) Amper modules are no longer automatically discovered by searching the whole file system hierarchy.\r\n  The [documentation](docs/Documentation.md) has been updated accordingly.\r\n  * In Gradle-based Amper projects, modules with a `module.yaml` file now need to be listed alongside other Gradle modules in `settings.gradle(.kts)`\r\n  * In multi-module projects using standalone Amper, a `project.yaml` file is now required and must list the modules to include in the project. Nothing changes for single-module projects.\r\n\r\n### Enhancements\r\n\r\n* [AMPER-685](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-685) User-friendly error message when a task doesn't exist\r\n* [AMPER-717](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-717) Fail fast if the Android SDK license isn't accepted\r\n* [AMPER-790](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-790) Inspection about incompatible settings or settings under an incorrect section\r\n\r\n### Bug fixes\r\n\r\n* [AMPER-494](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-494) 'buildSrc' cannot be used as a project name as it is a reserved name\r\n* [AMPER-624](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-624) Compilation fails with language version 2.0\r\n* [AMPER-689](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-689) Fail to resolve kotlin-test-annotations-common in a multiplatform context\r\n* [AMPER-836](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-836) Support repositories basic authentication in DR\r\n* [AMPER-910](https://youtrack.jetbrains.com/issue/AMPER-910) 'Redundant setting' inspection false positive\r\n"

    "body": "**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/JetBrains/kotlin-toolchain/compare/v0.2.2...v0.3.0\r\n\r\nSee our [release blog post](https://blog.jetbrains.com/amper/2024/05/amper-update-may-2024/) for the highlights, and to\r\nlearn about the tooling improvements.\r\n\r\n* Standalone version of Amper. See the [usage instructions](docs/Usage.md#using-the-standalone-amper-version-from-the-command-line).\r\n  * Build, test, and run JVM and Android applications in CLI and Fleet.\r\n  * iOS support is on the way.\r\n  * Standalone Amper can automatically download and configure the build environment, such as JDK, Android SDK.\r\n* Gradle-based Amper has been updated with the following plugins:\r\n  * Kotlin 2.0.0-RC3\r\n  * Compose 1.6.10-rc01\r\n  * Android 8.2\r\n* Gradle 8.6 is recommended for the Gradle-based Amper. Gradle 8.7+ is not yet supported. \r\n* Support the Wasm platform for libraries. \r\n\r\n### Breaking changes\r\n\r\nAmper now uses the `release` javac option instead of `target` and `source` to compile the Java code. \r\nThis version is also passed to the Kotlin compiler on the JVM platform.   \r\n\r\nYou need to update your configuration files. If you have the following settings:\r\n\r\n```yaml\r\nsettings:\r\n  java:\r\n    source: 17\r\n  jvm:\r\n    target: 17\r\n```\r\n\r\nRemove `java:source:` and change `jvm:target:` to `jvm:release:`: \r\n```yaml\r\nsettings:\r\n  jvm:\r\n    release: 17\r\n```\r\n\r\nSee the [DSL reference](docs/DSLReference.md#jvm) for details."

{"id":"GHSA-574f-3g2m-x479","summary":"Bouncy Castle for Java GOST 28147 CTR mode reuses keystream after 255 blocks","details":"The GOST 28147-2015 CTR mode implementation (`G3413CTRBlockCipher`) in the Legion of the Bouncy Castle BC-JAVA `bcprov` core module only increments the final byte of the counter, so the counter wraps after 255 blocks and the keystream is reused. Reusing CTR keystream allows an attacker who can observe two ciphertexts produced with the same key/IV to recover the XOR of the plaintexts, breaking confidentiality. Affects BC-JAVA from 1.59 before 1.84 (with backported fixes in 1.80.2 and In applications where the output buffer is reused without being cleared, this may lead to disclosure of sensitive data.

JNI-based implementations are *not* affected.

### Details

During the decompression process, the lz4 algorithm may have to repeat data that was previously decompressed in the same input frame. In the Java implementation, this is implemented by copy operations within the output buffer.

With a crafted input, an attacker may induce the Java implementation to copy from a region in the output buffer that does not contain decompressed data yet. If that region contains sensitive information because the output buffer was not cleared prior to decompression, that data will then be copied to the decompressed output.

- `LZ4Factory.nativeInstance().safeDecompressor()` *is not* affected.
- `LZ4Factory.nativeInstance().fastDecompressor()` *is* affected because it actually uses `safeInstance()` since 1.8.1. In 1.8.0 and earlier versions, this implementation is instead vulnerable to the more severe [CVE‐2025‐12183](https://sites.google.com/sonatype.com/vulnerabilities/cve-2025-12183), so downgrading is not a solution.
- Both decompressors of `LZ4Factory.safeInstance()`, `LZ4Factory.unsafeInstance()` and `LZ4Factory.fastestJavaInstance()` are affected.
- `LZ4Factory.fastestInstance()` uses the `nativeInstance` or `fastestJavaInstance` depending on platform. `LZ4Factory.fastestInstance().fastDecompressor()` is always affected, while `LZ4Factory.fastestInstance().safeDecompressor()` is affected only when JNI cannot be used (e.g. on unsupported platforms).

Independent of this vulnerability, it is recommended that users migrate from `fastDecompressor` to `safeDecompressor`, as the latter is more performant (despite the name).

The impact of this vulnerability depends on how user code interacts with the decompression API. Users that allocate a new destination buffer each time, or use only zeroed buffers, are not impacted. When the buffer is reused, however, the confidentiality impact can be severe. This vulnerability is marked as VC:H out of caution.

### Mitigation

lz4-java 1.10.1 fixes this issue without requiring changes in user code.

If you cannot upgrade to 1.10.1, you can mitigate this vulnerability by zeroing the output buffer before passing it to the decompression function.

### Relation to CVE‐2025‐12183

This CVE is a different attack than [CVE‐2025‐12183](https://sites.google.com/sonatype.com/vulnerabilities/cve-2025-12183), affecting different implementations with different impact. This new vulnerability was discovered by [CodeIntelligence](https://www.code-intelligence.com/) during research that followed up on CVE‐2025‐12183. Users are recommended to upgrade to 1.10.1 to fix both {"id":"GHSA-rcgg-9c38-7xpx","summary":"OpenTelemetry Java SDK has Unbounded Memory Allocation in W3C Baggage Propagation","details":"## Overview

A vulnerability affects the baggage propagation implementation in
`opentelemetry-api` and `opentelemetry-extension-trace-propagators`. Parsing oversized baggage
causes unbounded memory allocation and CPU consumption. Because baggage is automatically
re-injected into every outgoing request, the effect can fan out to downstream services that
never received the original malicious request.

## Technical Details

- `W3CBaggagePropagator` did not enforce any limit on the total size or entry count of the
  `baggage` header. The parser iterated character-by-character through the entire value
  regardless of length.
- `JaegerPropagator` and `OtTracePropagator` had the same gap in their respective baggage
  extraction paths.
- The W3C Baggage specification recommends a maximum of 8,192 bytes and 180 entries; none of
  these limits were enforced.

## Impact

The practical availability impact for most deployments is limited. Every major Java HTTP server
enforces its own header size limit (Tomcat, Jetty, Netty, Vert.x, and gRPC-Java all default to
8 KiB), constraining what an external attacker can deliver before the application is reached.
The risk is higher when transport-layer limits are absent — e.g., a compromised internal service
communicating over a non-HTTP or custom transport.

## Remediation

Update to version 1.62.0 or later ([#8380](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java/pull/8380)).
The fix enforces limits consistent with the W3C Baggage specification at the propagator level:

- Maximum total baggage size: 8,192 bytes across all `baggage` header values
- Maximum number of entries: 64

Headers that would exceed either limit are dropped at the point the limit is reached;
already-extracted valid entries are retained.

## Workarounds

Ensure HTTP header size limits are configured at the server or gateway level. Most Java HTTP
servers enforce an 8 KiB header limit by default, which mitigates external attack vectors
independently of this fix.

## References

- [W3C Baggage Specification {"id":"GHSA-xx22-p4ch-683r","summary":"LZ4 Java: Native XXHash implementations can crash the JVM when passed invalid byte array ranges","details":"### Summary

Insufficient validation of byte array arguments in JNI-based XXHash implementations in lz4-java 1.11.0 and earlier allows callers to crash the JVM by passing an invalid array reference or invalid range to native XXHash methods.

This affects applications where an attacker can influence the byte array object or the `off` / `len` arguments passed to affected XXHash APIs. It does **not** affect the common case where only the contents of a valid byte array are attacker-controlled.

Java-based XXHash implementations are *not* affected.

### Details

The JNI-backed XXHash implementations pass caller-provided byte array arguments to native code. The affected APIs are:

- `XXHashFactory.nativeInstance().hash32().hash(byte[] buf, int off, int len, int seed)`
- `XXHashFactory.nativeInstance().hash64().hash(byte[] buf, int off, int len, long seed)`
- `XXHashFactory.nativeInstance().newStreamingHash32(seed).update(byte[] bytes, int off, int len)`
- `XXHashFactory.nativeInstance().newStreamingHash64(seed).update(byte[] bytes, int off, int len)`

Before the fix, the streaming JNI implementations did not validate `bytes`, `off`, or `len` before calling `XXHashJNI.XXH32_update` / `XXHashJNI.XXH64_update`. The non-streaming JNI implementations called `SafeUtils.checkRange`, but `SafeUtils.checkRange(byte[], int, int)` skipped all array access when `len == 0`, so a null byte array with a zero length could still reach JNI.

As a result:

- `hash(null, 0, 0, seed)` and `update(null, 0, 0)` could pass a null array reference to JNI, causing a fatal JVM crash in `GetPrimitiveArrayCritical`.
- `update(new byte[16], 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE)` could cause native XXHash code to read far beyond the end of the Java array, causing a fatal JVM crash and potentially exposing in-process memory to the native routine before the crash.

The oversized-length non-streaming `hash(new byte[16], 0, Integer.MAX_VALUE, seed)` case was already rejected in Java before this fix. The missing validation affected the streaming oversized-length case and the zero-length null-array case for both streaming and non-streaming JNI XXHash APIs.

The impact of this vulnerability depends on how user code uses the XXHash API. Code that hashes attacker-controlled byte contents in a valid, correctly bounded array is not affected. Code may be affected if an attacker can cause the application to pass a null array, an attacker-controlled offset, or an attacker-controlled length to the native XXHash API. The primary impact is denial of service due to JVM termination. For oversized lengths, native code may also read outside the Java array before the process crashes.

### Mitigation

lz4-java 1.11.1 fixes this issue without requiring changes in user code.

If you cannot upgrade, avoid passing attacker-controlled array references, offsets, or lengths to JNI-backed XXHash APIs. In particular, validate that arrays are non-null and that `off` and `len` describe a range fully contained in the array before calling native XXHash methods.

Using `XXHashFactory.safeInstance()` avoids the JNI boundary and is not affected by this native crash behavior.","aliases":["CVE-2026-59949"],"modified":"2026-09-10T03:51:12.782091174Z","published":"2026-07-24T16:13:41Z","database_specific":{"github_reviewed_at":"2026-07-24T16:13:41Z","nvd_published_at":null,"cwe_ids":["CWE-125","CWE-476"],"severity":"MODERATE","github_reviewed":true},"references":[{"type":"WEB","url":"https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/security/advisories/GHSA-xx22-p4ch-683r"},{"type":"WEB","url":"https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/commit/dbd86d04b8dd716e1c2bc626be54189997d910da"},{"type":"PACKAGE","url":"https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java"},{"type":"WEB","url":"https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/releases/tag/v1.11.1"}],"affected":[{"package":{"name":"at.yawk.lz4:lz4-java","ecosystem":"Maven","purl":"pkg:maven/at.yawk.lz4/lz4-java"},"ranges":[{"type":"ECOSYSTEM","events":[{"introduced":"0"},{"fixed":"1.11.1"}]}],"versions":["1.10.0","1.10.1","1.10.2","1.10.3","1.10.4","1.11.0","1.8.1","1.9.0"],"database_specific":{"source":"https://github.com/github/advisory-database/blob/main/advisories/github-reviewed/2026/07/GHSA-xx22-p4ch-683r/GHSA-xx22-p4ch-683r.json","last_known_affected_version_range":"<= 1.11.0"}},{"package":{"name":"org.lz4:lz4-java","ecosystem":"Maven","purl":"pkg:maven/org.lz4/lz4-java"},"ranges":[{"type":"ECOSYSTEM","events":[{"introduced":"0"},{"last_affected":"1.8.1"}]}],"versions":["1.4","1.4.0","1.4.1","1.5.0","1.5.1","1.6.0","1.7.0","1.7.1","1.8.0","1.8.1"],"database_specific":{"source":"https://github.com/github/advisory-database/blob/main/advisories/github-reviewed/2026/07/GHSA-xx22-p4ch-683r/GHSA-xx22-p4ch-683r.json"}}],"schema_version":"1.9.0","severity":[{"type":"CVSS_V3","score":"CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:H"}]}
